key_impacts: 198 people were killed during the event
In Fenadesal Sur, 30 houses were destroyed and more than 100 damaged
About 300 residents in Fenadesal Sur evacuated to safety in time
Floodwaters ripped away bridges and obliterated homes in Fenadesal Sur
Heavy rains triggered a major landslide in the town of Verapaz
evidence_snippets: In November 2009 a torrential rainstorm hit central El Salvador; rivers rose and 198 people were killed.
The losses were serious—30 houses destroyed and more than 100 damaged; 300 people made it to safety.
Heavy rains triggered a major landslide in the town of Verapaz.
